name: Omawin
author: Diogo Chaves
description: Start, connect to and stop Omarchy's Docker-based Windows VM from the bar, tune its cores, RAM and disk, and keep its RDP login, with no access to the Docker socket: status comes from /proc, a cgroup freeze file and a TCP probe of the guest's RDP port.

barWidget.description: State of the Omarchy Windows VM, with Start, Connect, Stop and its shape and login.
